snapshot.agent_notes: Read-only public gateway. Authentication is not required; no account, login, private access material, or 2FA is required. Pricing for this reference corpus is free. Readiness score, availability, price-band, GTIN, and shipping-weight values are static public snapshot signals from the source Procurement Readiness Index, while Packrift.com remains the source of truth for buying, pricing, availability, shipping, and delivery. This is not a purchase-record, carrier-pricing, supplier-economics, profitability-math, private-source-path, or private-access-material source.
snapshot.description: Packrift Procurement Readiness Gateway exposes a compact public API and dataset surface for static Packrift procurement-readiness snapshot signals from the already published Procurement Readiness Index. It is a reference surface for agents and crawlers, not a buying, fulfillment, carrier-pricing, supplier-economics, profitability-math, purchase-record, or live-availability source.
snapshot.x_packrift_count_boundary: Static public reference data only. Packrift.com remains source of truth for buying, live pricing, availability, shipping, and delivery.
